response.jobDescription:
• Responsibilities
    • You are responsible for managing sourcing activities, including tendering processes, bid evaluations, negotiations (including e-auctions), contract drafting, and supplier management for indirect procurement categories (primarily facility management services, general equipment and supplies, as well as journal and database subscriptions).
    • You prepare and independently negotiate framework agreements with strategic suppliers.
    • You prepare commercial bid comparisons and award recommendations in close cooperation with the requesting business departments.
    • You manage and maintain purchase orders, contract amendments, framework agreements, and supplier master data in SAP SRM and SAP MM.
    • You actively contribute to the development and implementation of procurement strategies.
    • You identify and realize cost-saving opportunities.
    • You conduct demand and benchmark analyses.
    • You identify potential e-catalog opportunities and drive the development of key suppliers and framework agreements.
    • You support process and change management initiatives as well as special projects.

  •  

    Qualifications

    • You hold a degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification.
    • Several years of professional experience in indirect procurement within an international purchasing environment would be advantageous.
    • Knowledge of contract law as well as proficiency in standard Microsoft Office applications and SAP MM is required; experience with SAP SRM is an advantage.
    • Fluent business-level English and German skills.
    • You stand out through your technical interest, confident demeanor, strong communication skills, and an independent, goal- and results-oriented working style.
